description: The main window. Serve is started from Rust, so the web view needs no shell access. It may move the window by its title bar, zoom its contents (Cmd + and Cmd -) and open links with the system and show files in Finder (files are opened through the app's open_file command, which keeps to Ombro's folders and the shared folders and only shows kinds that run code), send system notifications when a job ends, and show the system's folder picker when a folder is shared.
